description: If \(p\) presents \(a\) at \(x\) and every \(a(k,x)\) is binary, then for every allowance \(n\) and requested cursor value \(m\), some state of the actual clipped simulation at \(x\) has cursor at least \(m\) or stored count equal to \(n\). No totality or change bound at any other input is required.
